form.label: Accelerated Activity
form.description: Opt-in summary view. Enable and validate VMware Vision Activity acceleration first. Only summarized events are shown; recent or older unsummarized data is omitted. Counts include repeated delivery and are not the deduplicated audit totals.

search.query: | tstats summariesonly=true count AS events FROM datamodel=VMware_Vision_Activity.Activity WHERE Activity.vcenter=$vc|s$ BY _time span=1h Activity.category Activity.vmware_action Activity.status | rename Activity.* AS *
stats sum(events) AS count by category
timechart span=1h sum(events) by vmware_action limit=15
stats min(_time) AS first_bucket max(_time) AS last_bucket sum(events) AS events | convert ctime(first_bucket) ctime(last_bucket)
